$comment: Shared copy and profile links for siteSettings, applied by scripts/migrate/content/fixes.mjs. Every string is copied from the live site (homepage, footer, /faq) as captured on 2026-10-13; every URL is one the live site links. Sources are listed per field. See README.md.

availabilityNote.source: Live /faq answer to 'Do you work on weekends or offer emergency service?': "Our regular office hours are Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. ... If you have an urgent situation, give us a call at 602-769-7892 and we'll do our best to accommodate you." Two of its sentences, with the phone number left out because the note is shown next to the phone number from Site settings. No 24/7 or emergency claim.
